source.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ይትበሀል፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ በሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ ይትኀሥሡ፡ ኅቡአተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ክፍለ፡ ኀይማኖት፡ እስመ፡ ሠረቀ፡ ከመ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ዲበ፡ *የብስ፡ ወ*ጽልመት፡ ኀለፈት።

translation.text: After this the holy ones in heaven will be told to seek the hidden things of righteousness, the portion of faith, for it has risen like the sun upon dry land, and darkness has passed away.[a]

footnotes.text: The whole unit continues onto the next page. Portion of faith preserves the selected words without adding a lottery or a previously unmentioned recipient. The selected rising clause has an unnamed singular subject, rendered it in English; this unit does not print a light noun or securely identify that antecedent. It has risen like the sun upon dry land, and darkness has passed away.
